title: Workflow
description: A Workflow is a navigable grouping of Pages above the Page level — a coherent user journey through a product Resource (e.g. the loan application flow). It gives module-scoped journeys a first-class, graph-queryable container.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the workflow.

description.description: A human-readable explanation of the user journey this workflow represents.

resource.description: The primary Resource this workflow operates on.

pages.description: The Pages that make up this workflow, in journey order. Each entry is the PascalCase name of a Page defined in this UI.

items.description: A reference to a Page by its PascalCase name.

examples.name: LoanApplication
examples.description: Guides an applicant from intake through submission.
